input.quote: 2. TERM. The term of this Agreement shall begin on the date hereof and shall continue until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6 hereof.
input.rationale: There is no auto-renewal anywhere in the Agreement. Section 2 (p0011) creates an evergreen term running until terminated under Section 6, and Section 6(a) (p0032) lets either party — including us — terminate for any or no reason on 15 days' notice whenever no Statement of Work is outstanding, i.e. well inside the preferred 30-day opt-out. New work only arises by mutually executed Statements of Work (p0004: "Statements of Work that are from time to time agreed upon shall reference this Agreement, and shall be executed by the parties"), so continued engagement effectively requires mutual written agreement rather than an automatic renewal. Because renewal is not automatic, the conditional automatic-renewal elements (12-month renewal term, 60-day Vendor reminder) and the renewal price-uplift cap are not engaged, and there is no non-renewal notice window to shorten. Noted but not flagged here: Section 3(b) (p0014) gives Contractor a unilateral right to change rates on 30 days' notice with no cap; that is a mid-term pricing mechanic rather than a renewal uplift and belongs to the pricing rule, not RENEWAL. No redline proposed under this rule.
